About Me

Meet Peterphonist

I'm Peter — a passionate saxophonist blending soul, rhythm, and creativity through powerful tunes and expressive performances. As part of the creative journey at @peterlightspeed, I share vibes that connect music lovers, creators, and fans alike.

With years of experience in professional saxophone performance, I specialize in creating memorable musical experiences for all types of events. My versatile style spans smooth jazz, contemporary, gospel, and popular music, ensuring the perfect soundtrack for any occasion.
